name: 最低料金を見ながら乗継回数を選ぶ条件
prompt:
Create a clean Japanese flight-stop filter on a white canvas, close to the original 1080:682 aspect ratio (1.58:1). The original crop controls the heading, three stacked rows, two-line text hierarchy, vertical spacing and right-aligned radio controls. The Japanese preview controls the exact Japanese copy, yen pricing, white surface, and compact appearance.

Show one bold heading “乗り継ぎ回数”. Beneath it, show exactly three unselected radio rows in this order, each with a dark label, a smaller muted gray fare line directly underneath, and one thin gray circular radio at the far right:
1. “直行便のみ” with “¥ 15,000から”
2. “1回まで” with “¥ 15,000から”
3. “2回まで” with “¥ 15,000から”

Keep all labels on the left, the three radio circles aligned on the right, and the fare amounts aligned beneath their labels. Use compact Japanese sans-serif text, comfortable row gaps, subtle gray prices, crisp empty radio circles, and ample white space. Keep the result a simple filter subsection, with no selected radio.

Do not include filter-sheet close/reset controls, “Filter by”, duration, sliders, flight-time tabs, a results button, extra explanatory copy, dividers, or watermark.
reviewNotes: Japanese stop-count filter; visually reviewed for three options, yen fares, radio alignment and clipping.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
